claim_scope: All integer d>=3 and all exact harmonic degrees ell>=0 for the complete normalized hypercube vertex set; rank and which Walsh characters are in the evaluation image.

integrity.computational_support: Exact-rational finite checker; not an infinite proof
integrity.proof_basis: Fischer decomposition and an all-index complex-null-coefficient argument

scientific_limitations: No condition-number bounds, partial-cube classification, weighted variant, low-pass identification, or independent global priority certificate. Full text of one related discrete-Hamming paper inaccessible.
title: A complete Walsh-sector rank law for spherical harmonics sampled at hypercube vertices
